answer: Before a payout clears, every claim sits in an open meadow where anyone may challenge it: submit proof that two identities share one operator — matching signatures, devices, or work — and the payout desk rules within a day. A proven duplicate forfeits its claim, and the challenger keeps a walnut-sized share as a bounty. An honest worker has nothing to hide and pays nothing, while 1,000 fakes would each face a crowd of hunters — a gap near 1,000 to 1. When one operator ran fifty copies of the same answer, the third was an echo of the first, a hunter proved it, and all fifty were voided.
